title: `toc_tokens` name for a header with `<b>` contains internal placeholder junk
spec: This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`. When a header contains raw HTML, the `name` in `md.toc_tokens` contains internal placeholder strings instead of text. ``` md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['markdown.extensions.toc']) md.convert('# Foo Bar Baz.') md.toc_tokens ``` Expected: ``` [{'level': 1, 'id': 'foo-bar-baz', 'name': 'Foo Bar Baz.', 'children': []}] ``` Actual: ``` [{'level': 1, 'id': 'foo-bar-baz', 'name': 'Foo \x02wzxhzdk:0\x03Bar\x02wzxhzdk:1\x03 Baz.', 'children': []}] ``` Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
